# Green Landscaping

> Landscape construction company in Sacramento, CA, serving Elk Grove and Rancho Cordova. Artificial turf, concrete patios, pavers and hardscape, retaining walls, sod/irrigation/drainage, decks/pergolas/fences, and full yard remodels. CSLB Licensed C-27 Landscaping Contractor, Lic. #1059991. Rated 4.7 stars across 38 Google reviews. Run by Jose and his crew.

Contact: call or text (916) 849-4844. Free estimates, typically same-day response.

## Services
- [Artificial Turf](https://greenlandscapingofsacramento.com/artificial-turf.html): Turf installed on compacted base with crushed rock, infill sand and drainage backing — kid- and pet-friendly, zero watering
- [Concrete & Patios](https://greenlandscapingofsacramento.com/concrete-patios.html): Patios, walkways and slabs with decorative borders, scoring, colored and exposed-aggregate finishes
- [Pavers & Hardscape](https://greenlandscapingofsacramento.com/pavers-hardscape.html): Paver patios and walkways, flagstone paths, river rock, boulders and dry stream beds
- [Retaining Walls](https://greenlandscapingofsacramento.com/retaining-walls.html): Straight, curved and terraced block walls with proper drainage backfill
- [Sod, Irrigation & Drainage](https://greenlandscapingofsacramento.com/sod-irrigation.html): New sod lawns, sprinkler and drip systems, French drains and catch basins
- [Decks, Pergolas & Fences](https://greenlandscapingofsacramento.com/decks-pergolas-fences.html): Composite decks, pergola builds and rebuilds, cedar privacy fences
- [Full Yard Remodels](https://greenlandscapingofsacramento.com/full-yard-remodels.html): Complete front/back yard transformations including drought-tolerant designs

## Primary services
Artificial turf installation and concrete (patios, walkways, slabs). Other services listed above are offered as part of larger turf/concrete projects.

## Service Areas
- [Elk Grove, CA](https://greenlandscapingofsacramento.com/elk-grove.html) — primary service area
- [Rancho Cordova, CA](https://greenlandscapingofsacramento.com/rancho-cordova.html)
- Sacramento, CA and the greater Sacramento area (north to Lincoln)

## FAQ
- Q: What does Green Landscaping specialize in?
  A: Artificial turf installation and concrete work (patios, walkways and slabs) for homes in Elk Grove, Rancho Cordova and Sacramento. Pavers, retaining walls and sod are done as part of larger turf or concrete projects. We do not offer lawn maintenance or mowing.
- Q: How long does a backyard turf and concrete project take?
  A: Most new-build backyards (turf plus a patio or walkway) are finished in about 3 to 7 working days depending on size, concrete cure time and weather. We give you a schedule with the quote.
- Q: Do you charge for estimates?
  A: No. On-site estimates are free. You get one exact number for the whole job, not a list of line items that changes later. Text a photo of your yard to (916) 849-4844 to start.
- Q: Do you work in HOA communities?
  A: Yes. Many of the newer communities in Elk Grove, Rancho Cordova and Sacramento have HOA design rules and a submittal process. We have done plenty of them and will prepare what the HOA needs.
- Q: Is Green Landscaping licensed?
  A: Yes. Green Landscaping of Sacramento is a CSLB-licensed C-27 Landscaping Contractor, license #1059991, operating since 2008. You can verify the license at cslb.ca.gov.
- Q: What areas do you serve?
  A: Elk Grove, Rancho Cordova, Sacramento, Folsom and the surrounding area, as far north as Lincoln. Our core work is in Elk Grove and Rancho Cordova new-build neighborhoods.
- Q: Why does turf fail, and how do you avoid it?
  A: Cheap turf jobs skip the base. We grade and compact the native soil, add a compacted crushed-rock layer, infill sand and a drainage backing before the turf goes down, so it never shifts, wrinkles or puddles.
